subject: maths

items.correct: The gradient / rate of change of a function.
items.random_wrong: The value of the function at x = 0.
items.why: Differentiation finds gradients; integration finds areas under curves.

items.q: What is the derivative of a constant?
items.why: A constant doesn't change, so its rate of change is 0; d/dx(x) = 1.

items.correct: The area under a curve (the reverse of differentiation).
items.why: Integration accumulates area and reverses differentiation (+C for indefinite integrals).
